description: The agent must: (1) Read weekly_trading_log.csv and account_capital.json to get all trade data and total capital (500,000 CNY). (2) Apply the single-stock position limit of 10% of capital (50,000 CNY) — flagging 600003 (80k) and 600007 (90k). (3) Apply the daily cumulative position limit of 30% (150,000 CNY) — flagging 2024-05-07 (total 218,000). (4) Apply the exact -7% stop-loss rule — flagging 600002, 600009, 600012, 600016 but NOT 600008 (only -6%). (5) Apply the split take-profit rule: +7% = sell half (600014), +15% = sell remaining half (600011, 600015), distinguishing the two tiers. (6) Identify 龙头 stocks using the proprietary criteria: consecutive_limit_up >= 3 AND 5% <= turnover_rate_pct <= 15% — correctly excluding 600013 (turnover 16.3% exceeds 15%). (7) Classify each trading day's emotion cycle stage (启动期/高潮期/退潮期/冰点期) based on the ratio of limit-up stocks to board breaks. Output all findings in compliance_report.json with the exact field names specified.
